title: Employment of emotional appeals in Zain television advertisements: analytical study of Ramadan and Eid al‑Fitr ads
core_idea: To identify the most commonly used emotional appeals, prevalent themes, and advertising elements in Zain telecommunications' Ramadan and Eid al‑Fitr television commercials by applying a survey methodology with content analysis to a sample of 31 ads.
tldr: A content‑analysis study that examines which emotional appeals and thematic elements Zain employs in its Ramadan and Eid al‑Fitr TV commercials to characterize the company's advertising strategies.
